claim: Fixture replay only. These extraction numbers verify the evaluation plumbing and frozen artifacts; they are not live extractor-v1 model quality.

annotated_scope.interpretation: Predictions restricted to documents included in the frozen extraction-gold annotation sample.

all_predictions_scope.interpretation: All extracted events in the partition versus the partial gold sample; false positives include unannotated true events and are not interpretable as hallucination.

limitations: The available extraction store is produced by the deterministic fixture extractor, not a live LLM.
Extraction gold is a 12-patient / 130-event annotation sample, so all-partition precision is not meaningful.
No live extraction latency or token cost can be attributed from this run.
